$comment: SAP-standard tables the adt_customizing data preview may read. Part of the read-only fence: a table enters by commit, reviewed in a diff (docs/security.md). Customer tables are added per installation with `npm run config -- table add`, validated by the same grammar. routineColumns maps a column (or a regex source matching a column family) to the VOFM group (lib/vofm-groups.mjs) whose routine NUMBER it carries; keyColumns is what the usage sweep prints as the row key.
